name: ui
description: Embedded workspace Knowledge UI contract. The Plane host serves the Knowledge web microfrontend through exactly two bounded edge routes and exchanges signed bootstrap assertions.

rules.routes: static assets on knowledge-web and the /api/knowledge proxy prefix on knowledge-api only; stateful and execution services never appear in any proxy file
rules.assertions: bootstrap assertions carry iat/exp claims, the effective capability list, and the shared-space revision; drift re-mints assertions
rules.capability_discovery: frontend capability discovery derives from the effective backend route set and fails closed
rules.host_callbacks: plane_page open/edit actions route through the typed host callback to the Plane Page editor
